ehalokika: [Iha+loka+ika] (ti) CL=8 Ihaloke jātaṃ ihalokikaṃ. Dhāna,ṭī.85] . it is being at present, it is face and enjoy at present life (effect).
ehi: [ i + a + hi.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā + i + a + hi ] (1) May you come. See - Eti (4). (2) May you enter. May you approach. May you revere. See - Eti (6).
[ ima (idaṃ) + hi-vibhata.] (ti) CL=7 With this. From this. See - Esaṃ.
ehibhaddantha: [(ehi + bhaddanta=) ehibhaddanta + ṇa.] (pu) CL=7 [Ruḷhī. See below]. The approaching manner that Venerable please may you come. See below.
ehibhaddanthika: [ ehibhaddanta + ṇika ] (ti) CL=7 One who approaches (someone) that says ' Venerable, please may you come'.
ehibhikkhu: [ ehi + bhikkhu.]  CL=9 Ehibhikkhunī in the feminine gender.] Ehibhikkhu monk. (bhikkhu = one who sees the danger of the cycle of rebirths. Ehi = Approach the Saraṇagamana- (the dispensation) keeping in mind that it protects one from the danger of the cycle of rebirths and is the hideout of those who fear the danger of the cycle of rebirths. Vimati, 1, 128. Ehi = Come, accept the state of monk that is asked for. Sārattha, 3, 182.)'
ehibhikkhubhāva: [ ehibhikkhu + bhāva ] (pu) CL=7 As a monk who is ordained by the oldest formula of admission to the Order.
ehibhikkhubhāvappatti: [ ehibhikkhubhāva + patti ] (thī) CL=7 Becomes an Ehibhikkhu.
ehibhikkhucīvara: [ ehibhikkhu + cīvara ] (pu,na) CL=7 The robe that is (finished with the power of) Ehibhikkhu.
ehibhikkhuduka: [ ehibhikkhu + duka ] (ti) CL=7 A group of two that is an Ehibhikkhu and a bhikkhu. Ehibhikkhuduka.
ehibhikkhuka: [ ehibhikkhu + ka ] (pu) CL=7 A monk who is ordained by the oldest formula of admission to the Order.
ehibhikkhunibhāva: [ ehibhikkhunī + bhāva ] (pu) CL=7 A state of one who is ordained by the formula 'become a nun'.
ehibhikkhuniduka: [ ehibhikkhunī + duka ] (ti) CL=7 Ehibhikkhuduka. See - Ehibhikkhuduka.
ehibhikkhunī: [ ehibhikkhu + inī (itthī paccaññaḥ) ] (thī) CL=7 A nun is called Ehibhikkhunī.
ehibhikkhunūpasampadā: [ ehibhikkhunī + upasampadā ] (thī) CL=7 The state of one who is ordained by the formula 'become a nun'.
ehibhikkhupabbajjā: [ ehibhikkhu + pabbajjā ] (thī) CL=7 As a monk who is ordained by the oldest formula of admission to the Order.
ehibhikkhūpasampadā: [ ehibhakkhu + upasampadā.] (thī) CL=7 [Ehi bhikkhu' iti bhagavato vacane‌na upasampadā ehibhikkhūpasampadā. Pā,gaṃ,saca.485.] One who becomes a bhikkhu by Lord Buddha"s words (sound) 'ehi bhikkhu' . As an Ehibhikkhū.
ehinti: [ i + ssanti.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā + i + ssanti] They will come. See - Eti (4).
ehipassavidhi: [ ehipassa + vidhi ] (pu) CL=7 The word (sound) - the method that you come and meditate. See below.
ehipassika: [ ehipassa + ṇika.] (ti) CL=7 [Rū,ṭī,nhā.165.ehipassavidhi+ṇika. Vi, pi,dhāna. Ehi passā' ti imaṃ vidhiṃ arahatīti ehipassiko. Rū,nhā. 225. Ehipassavidhiṃ arahatīti ehipassiko. Moga,4. 28. Ehi passa imaṃ dhammanti evaṃ pavattaṃ ehipassavidhiṃ arahatīti attho. Nīti, sutta,nhā. 237. Ehi ca passa ca ehi-passa, ehipassa iti vidhānaṃ araha-tīti ehipassiko. Nirutti,nhā. 280. Visuddhi, prañña,sya. ] (A) (Dhamma) that worth to say and arrange that you come and meditate. (B) (The practice) that is worthy to instruct that you come and meditate.
ehisi: [ i + ssasi.] (kri) CL=7 [Ā + i + ssasi.] (1) You will go. See - Eti (1). (2) You come. See - Eti (4).
ehisvāgatavādī: [ ehisvāgata + vada + ṇī ] (ti) CL=7 Saying 'come, you are welcome'.
ehiti: [ i + ssati.] (kri) CL=7 He will come. See - Eti (4).
